OWN GYM

The Idea

A fitness-focused digital experience combining a clean, energetic web design with a straightforward e-commerce component — built as a self-directed project to explore how a gym or fitness brand could present itself and sell products online.

Design Direction

The interface favors a clear, no-clutter layout so visitors can move between information and products without friction, with a visual tone suited to a fitness and e-commerce context.

Design & Build

Client Project

51 WEST

The Idea

A fire-grilled, hand-plated restaurant experience for 51 West Restaurant in Narayanganj — a browsable menu with an always-visible cart that hands the finished order straight to WhatsApp for cash-on-delivery.

Design Direction

A bold, appetite-forward interface with clear menu categories, live offers and a fast, mobile-first ordering flow, since most orders come in from a phone.
